name: my bosses have become super obsessed with an otome game!?
source:
Your day-to-day's hard enough already,  considering you work for the kingdom's most notorious noble daughters. Before, it was all insults and bratty tantrums, now,  it's all "I need to escape the villainess route" or "I will become the final boss"...

And to make things worse: you've just gotten kidnapped.

Well, look on the bright side! Maybe you'll get rescued by that hot and dreamy guy you just befriended!

...he's not the reason you're locked up in there, right?

[From [url=https://cowboy-starshine.itch.io/idk-x-2]itch.io[/url]]
